scope: Discovery-aware People records and menu disclosure; supported contacts only.

findings: A fresh opening has no record or Notebook. The actual greeting introduces only the elder. Records are readable during dialogue while actions/empty tabs stay hidden; expansion and focus survive ticks.

Native travel retains the selected People view and learned record away from Village. Reload retains its native greeting marker without granting rewards, moving NPCs or enrolling life/work. Travel access is generated for this bounded proof.

Generated native craftsman access reveals only his name/place. Enrollment adds no preferences. Actual questions and a real paid/material commission add their own evidence, survive reload, and leave the hidden relationship axis intact.
The optional permit does not introduce the clerk. The actual office briefing does, revealing the agreed work without settlement or later-ledger spoilers.

Notebook has its own native Journal tab and no DOM under the location menu. Fresh opening hides the new tab; local clues remain vague. Keyboard focus/user selection survive ticks; saved practice opens its Journal view and cancels there.

An old generated town save derives one contract in native Quests, retaining money/inventory/native quest state through reload. Local notes do not reveal the answer or later ledger. The separate list avoids the native quest sorter; no quest is copied into Notebook.
Generated independent discovery flags reveal world name and branch separately; native Save/reload retains both learned facts. No live reveal event or automatic discovery is added.

Native center menu, real player-to-NPC material transfer, paid commission, directed trust, independent bench work, mid-job reload and exactly-once native kit collection pass. Native story access is generated in the fixture; this does not prove natural rat-field progression.
Learned method, native Shack access, per-batch wood/coin reservation, pending reload, refund/cancel and three-batch automatic completion create real kits.

A real native encoded export is reimported through the file input and real-loader preflight; native ownership, actor work, generated native NPC equipment and completed routine remain intact after reload.
Injected quota failure publishes no transfer, money debit, claim, relationship or advanced clock; reload restores the original eligible commission.
An undiscovered generated decision does not freeze the player; supported time reaches its deadline and frozen aftermath settles without an invisible input prompt.
Native-menu enrollment, real stamina cost, saved partial encounter, debrief and timed lesson pass.
Hostile intent, functional restraint, informed Village reputation and explicit restitution pass.
Timed promise, mid-job reload, real manual inheritance, native encoded export/import through the real preflight and no duplicate bequest pass.
Generated time jump misses real windows; local reports preserve information without granting missed rewards.
Attended briefing contributes usable preparation through the existing capability/read model.
Stronger generated native XP build wins against the same fixed elder.
Ordinary wolf-rat combat, timer cleanup on return and native guard spar remain playable.
Injected storage failure publishes no turn/stamina/calendar change; reload restores the committed encounter.
Opt-in old age ends once, freezes native game time, survives reload and exports through the native-compatible encoding.

limits: Supported elder/craftsman/clerk/pathfinder bindings, not a complete NPC census or general observation ledger.
No new save schema, rumor system, faction catalogue or world travel.
Other work was updating the shared checkout; compiled-source hashes identify the reviewed runtime.
Wording/menu density and broader authoring remain human/content gates.
